author: Tazz
body:
Authors: Tazz, Robin_DD_J and Caiiden

Contributors: Jive 

Images: http://imgur.com/a/fKgx8
Download: On Alex's server, someone help please? The world name is 'Tazz'.
YML: Needed  - anyone?

This is a map that Robin abandoned as he didn't like it; I decided to take it over because I loved it and saw potential.
  
Features:
  • Spawn Timer
  • 2 wools per side - Blue VS Red
  • Extra supplies in spawn
  • Two different wool room lane designs - one is tunnel prevented but the other is quite easy to tunnel into.
  • Diamond chestplate, power 1 bows and 2 stacks of Gapples in wool rooms
  • Water on each side
  • Spawn kit: http://imgur.com/lk6MZJi - Bow = Infinity + UB 3 (add an arrow above bow in kit XD) Pickaxe = Eff 2 UB 3

If you can help getting the download or if you are alex, OR you can do YML (mapdevs pl0x), add me on Skype @MrTazz4077

Feedback is appreciated

-Tazz and Robin

replies.author: hasl
replies.body:
Right, well...

  ⋙Short feedback
       ⇸ I must say the positioning of the islands is very unique, however it may cause gameplay issues such as: extremely quick to get onto enemy ground; on respawn very quick to get back into the fight; skybridges would be a hassle and the problem of getting combo'd very easily when jumping when going up raising ground. Despite some of those gameplay issues, the map is very pleasing and innovative to look at when spectating (key in tournaments). So overall a fairly decent map in my eyes.

  ⋙Extended feedback
       ⇸ Aesthetics, straight up it catches your eye on the right angled island end point and how it's a single strip of land to hold pvp, defences, skybridges and more in, and to build a map that is strong in all those areas is unimaginably difficult, and I think you're half way there on that, I can see why Robin decided to abandon this map which I heard would be a show stopper, and I can see why: so for you to take the map on is a very brave thing to do as it wasn't even your idea in the first place, so you have no idea what Robin had exactly in mind. 7/10

       ⇸ Gameplay, immediately you can tell this can be rushed very quickly or stalemated way to fast, without testing it's impossible to tell what will happen. The main reason I'm worried about this map is its size and the distance from the end of your island relative to the wool rooms which are in front of the spawn, add a 5 second spawn timer and bridging, almost impossible to get back into the fight once you're dead. I don't really think there's enough space for tournament quality pvp let alone 5 man push strategies, would definitely be a bow spam on the ground, and skybridge would be incredibly be fast with max speed ninja bridging or even faster with breezling. 6/10

       ⇸ Creativity, the map is astonishingly unique and has a lot of design characteristics I haven't seen since the ParaPenguin era. The shape and non-symmetrical style is a nice change, doesn't remind me of any other map and is a great build for the creative players. However I feel the creativity has limited you from expanding the map for better gameplay, so it's a bit too creative I think. 6/10

-Aura
